subject: Axe in Fireberg
text: The axe in Fireberg is missable: a player who reached the end of the game without buying it could not buy it afterwards.

evidence.quote: This is missable.  I got to the end of the game without buying the axe in fireberg.  and she wouldn't sell it to me afterwards.

subject: Great Value Vega
text: A player reports that after gathering the three claws the all-claws achievement did not pop up.

evidence.quote: I gathered the three claws, but the achievement didn't pop up.

subject: Great Value Vega
text: suspect15 says there is no problem with the achievement, and almost 2,000 people have unlocked it without issue.

evidence.quote: [suspect15] There's no a problem with the achievement.  Almost 2,000 people have unlocked it without issue.

subject: Great Value Vega

subject: Helmet from the lady
text: The helmet from the lady is missable if you never get the Steel Helm and get the Moon/Apollo helms; the lady will not sell it if you return later.

evidence.quote: This is missable if you never get the Steel Helm and get the Moon/Apollo helms. The lady will not sell you this helmet if you return later to do clean up on anything missed.
